name: 66213 · Overland Park, KS
findings: ZIP 66213 (Overland Park) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66213 (Overland Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 7 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
